source: recorded from spec §2.2 native tool:* section descriptions (installed @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-* packages not readable at fixture-record time; re-record live in Round 3)

sections.tool:read: Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat — to inspect text files. Results include line numbers. Use offset and limit to continue reading large files.
sections.tool:grep: Use the grep tool — not shell grep or rg — to search file contents. Returns matching lines with line numbers, grouped by file. Use read on a matched file when you need surrounding context.
sections.tool:glob: Use the glob tool — not shell find — to discover files by path pattern. Results are files only, never directories. A pattern with no separator matches basenames at any depth.
sections.tool:write: Use the write tool to create files or completely replace file contents. Existing files are overwritten, so read an existing file first. Prefer edit for targeted changes.
sections.tool:edit: Use edit for targeted changes to an existing UTF-8 text file. It replaces literal old_string with new_string; old_string must appear exactly once unless replace_all is set. Read the file first unless you just created or edited it in this session.
sections.tool:pwsh: Execute a PowerShell command (pwsh -Command) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process: no cwd, variables or functions persist between calls — pass workdir instead of using cd. Non-zero exits are reported as [exit code: N] markers. Not for reading or searching files — use read/grep/glob.
sections.tool:bash: Execute a bash command and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh process: no state persists between calls. Not for reading or searching files — use read/grep/glob.
sections.tool:job_output: Read a background job by the job id returned by the tool that started it. Reads are non-blocking unless wait is true. Do not busy-poll or sleep on a job.
sections.tool:subagent: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent working in its own context. Give it a complete standalone prompt: it does not see this conversation. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps.
sections.tool:web_search: Search the web for current information. Returns an optional summary answer and a list of source URLs. Cite the relevant URLs as markdown links.
